column1: # H3d: cc interop inbound wrappers (`__ccw_N:` labels; src/back_lower.c:925-941).  A ccw label arms `ccw`=1; before the next
# instruction arm64 prints `hentry R7` (the host's argument registers are already r0..r5), x86-64 prints the six host-argument
# moves (r(k) <- host argument k, in order); `ccw`=2 then lasts up to the wrapper's `ret`, which arm64 prints as `hleave`.
# Windows has no host ABI wrapper in the reference (it exits 1): rejected as not covered.
